trends.summary: Batch_1 and Batch_2 maintain stable recovery around 98.4% (IQR 2.1%), whereas Batch_3 shifts systematically downward to median 84.1% (one-way F=26.4, eta_sq=0.68).
trends.baseline_or_interval: Across 3 analytical batches vs certified reference standard (100% nominal)

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: Calibration slope drift or fresh mobile-phase lot preparation shifted all Batch_3 recoveries downward.
supporting_evidence: All 8 valid Batch_3 samples shifted uniformly (-12% to -16%)
excluding_evidence: Does not explain isolated extreme drop in Batch_1 sample S_014 (42.3%)
causal_hypotheses.correlation_vs_causation_caveat: Batch clustering shows association with run day/lot, not yet confirmed as reagent vs column drift.
causal_hypotheses.falsification_test: Compare Batch_3 internal-standard peak area and calibration curve slope in Sheet Cal_Curves against Batch_1/2.

causal_hypotheses.hypothesis: Sample S_014 experienced a dilution or injection volume error (approx. 2x under-injection).
supporting_evidence: Observed 42.3% is near half of Batch_1 median while neighboring wells S_013/S_015 are 98.2%/99.1%
causal_hypotheses.correlation_vs_causation_caveat: Single-sample drop could also stem from vial septum air bubble or matrix precipitation.
causal_hypotheses.falsification_test: Inspect raw autosampler injection pressure trace and ELN dilution log for S_014.

verification_checklist.action: Compare Batch_3 calibration slope and internal-standard response against Batch_1/2 acceptance window (95-105%)
verification_checklist.decision_rule: If Batch_3 internal standard dropped > 10%, flag Batch_3 for re-injection with fresh calibration.

verification_checklist.target_file_or_log: autosampler_log.txt row S_014 & ELN entry EXP-014
verification_checklist.action: Check recorded injection volume, pressure trace, and manual dilution weight for S_014
verification_checklist.decision_rule: If volume/weight deviates > 5% from protocol, document as confirmed preparation deviation and exclude from efficacy mean.

next_experiments.change: Inject 3 archived QC standards from Batch_1 alongside Batch_3 retained vials under the current mobile phase.

retained_ambiguities: Workbook Sheet Methods lists LOQ as 0.5 ug/mL while manuscript section 2.3 states 0.25 mg/L (0.25 ug/mL); both retained pending author verification.

six_element_traceability.controls: Certified reference standard + solvent blank (explicit zero)
six_element_traceability.equipment_materials: HPLC-UV system + Batch_1/2/3 mobile phase lots
six_element_traceability.risks_anomalies: 1 isolated low outlier (S_014), 1 systematic batch shift (Batch_3), 2 data gaps (1 missing, 1 BLQ)
